subject: Post-signature Sprint-0 playbook & canary cadence — HelioNova MAP
messages:
From: Samuel Reed <sam.reed@heliosnova.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@heliosnova.com>, delivery@heliosnova.com
Date: Mon, 11 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: post-signature MAP + Sprint 0 details

Irene —

Thanks again for a smooth close. Contract signed and countersigned (DocuSign link below). To keep momentum, our exec team would like a concise Sprint-0 playbook embedded in the MAP that covers a) canary cadence, b) migration approach (data + model variants), and c) training windows for our ops/admins and pilot users. Target go-live objective is end of September; wed like to begin Sprint-0 work the week of Aug 25 with a canary starting the week of Aug 26, presuming SSO/SCIM readiness.

Key asks from our side:
- Draft Sprint-0 playbook + canary schedule by Aug 13
- List of acceptance criteria and rollback gates
- Training roster template and suggested agenda (admin + user)
- Any gating items for procurement/invoicing to lock schedule

Can you confirm whether Aug 25 as Sprint-0 start looks feasible? Also loop in ops/implementation folks from your side.

Appreciate it —
Sam
HelioNova 
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/signature/abc123-contract

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Samuel Reed <sam.reed@heliosnova.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Aug 2025 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: post-signature MAP + Sprint 0 details

Sam —

Great to hear — congrats and welcome aboard. Weve sketched a Sprint-0 playbook that we can fold into the mutual-action-plan; attaching the first-pass artifacts: sprint0_playbook_v1.pdf, canary_schedule_v1.xlsx, and a training_roster_template.csv. High-level proposal below.

Sprint-0 / canary summary (proposed)
- Sprint-0 window: Aug 25 	6 Sep 5 (2 weeks): environment prep, SSO/SCIM validation, prefilling caches, KV warming, and smoke test suite run.
- Canary window: Aug 26 	6 Sep 12 (rolling): 0.5% -> 1% -> 5% -> 20% production traffic ramps across 4 checkpoints (24-48h between increments).
- Rollback / gating: automated latency/error thresholds (defined in canary sheet), data drift checks on embeddings, and acceptance criteria for each ramp. Manual hold if any critical alerts.
- Migration approach: blue/green for model variants; warm KV caches for top 200 prefixes; snapshot backups before switch.
- Training: two admin enablement sessions + one user pilot training in week 2 of Sprint-0. We'll provide slide deck + hands-on lab.
- Ops handoff: runbook and escalation path; we recommend daily 09:30 standups during canary and a mid-day readiness review before each ramp.

Open items for HelioNova to confirm:
1) SSO/SCIM delivery date (needed for Aug 20 cutover)
2) Pilot user list for training (role + email)
3) Any compliance sign-offs beyond SOC2 (if so, we'll schedule a security questionnaire drop)

If that all looks good Ill update the MAP and send a version with specific owners and dates by Aug 13.

— Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
Attachments: sprint0_playbook_v1.pdf (pdf), canary_schedule_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), training_roster_template.csv (csv)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Samuel Reed <sam.reed@heliosnova.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Aug 2025 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kickoff: post-signature MAP + Sprint 0 details

Looping in a few ops details from implementation that refine the canary gates:
- Provision a small dedicated pool (1x-capped) for initial canary traffic to guarantee latency SLAs; we can scale to shared pools after 20% traffic.
- Canary ramp plan in the sheet uses 24h windows; recommend we add an automated KV-warm step (script runs) before moving to next ramp.
- Monitoring hooks: we will add token-level latency dashboards and an automated rollback trigger at 3 consecutive p50 > 650ms or p95 > 1.2s, or if error rate > 1% sustained for 15 minutes.
- Ops artifact attached: ops_canary_gates.pdf (runbook excerpt)

Irene: if HelioNova confirms SSO date, well reserve the pool and schedule a dry-run the week of Aug 18.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Principal Implementation Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Kickoff: post-signature MAP + Sprint 0 details

Thanks — this looks good and very thorough. Quick updates from HelioNova:
- SSO/SCIM team expects to hand off a working configuration by Aug 20 (we'll confirm by Aug 15).
- We want the canary start pushed to Aug 26 to give our infra team a couple extra days; Sprint-0 kickoff on Aug 25 still works for us.
- Training: please schedule two admin sessions (Aug 27 & 28) and one pilot user session (Sep 3). We will send attendee names by Aug 18.
- Procurement question: can you confirm invoicing cadence? We were expecting 30% upon signature, 40% at canary start, 30% at GA. Procurement is on copy and will confirm contract terms.

Also please share the MAP with owners/assignees once youve updated it.

Regards,
Leah Torres
